title.en: Providing for the Proper Recording and Keeping of Mining Instruments and Documents

text.en:
The registers of deeds as ex-officio mining recorders under Commonwealth Act No. 137 shall
continue to act as such mining recorders for the registration of mining instruments or documents, except
original declarations of location, pertaining or relating to, or affecting mining claims located or mining rights
acquired prior to May 18, 1974 under Commonwealth Act No. 137, as amended, and the implementing rules
and regulations thereof, and shall be responsible for the safekeeping of such recorded instruments or
documents in their custody and the issuance of certified true copies thereof, subject to the payment of such
fees as may be determined by the Director of Mines with the approval of the Secretary of Natural Resources.
Such fees shall accrue to the province or city concerned and shall be allocated for the facilities and services
that may be required to keep and maintain the Office of the Mining Recorder.

Mining instruments and documents required or allowed to be registered under Presidential
Decree No. 483 after May 18, 1974, shall be recorded with the Mines Regional Officers and such other
persons as may be appointed or designated by the Director of Mines. The Director shall be responsible for the
proper recording of such documents and instruments and shall issue such forms, rules and regulations to
implement this Decree.

Any provisions of existing law, decree, order or regulation, inconsistent herewith are hereby
repealed or amended accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 19th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-four.
